output.text:
I fixed the bug, and all 5 unit tests in `test/slug.test.js` now pass. The property tests in `test/slug.property.test.js` haven't run yet because `fast-check` isn't installed.

**The bug:** in `src/slug.js:14`, the regex that strips separators from the start and end of the slug was missing the `g` (global) flag:

```js
.replace(new RegExp(`^${sep}|${sep}$`), '')        // before
.replace(new RegExp(`^${sep}|${sep}$`, 'g'), '')   // after
```

Without `g`, `replace` only removes the first match. So when a title had punctuation or spaces at both ends, only the leading separator was removed. For example, `'  Hello, World!  '` came out as `'hello-world-'` instead of `'hello-world'`.

**Property tests:** they fail with `Cannot find module 'fast-check'`. It's listed in `devDependencies` but there's no `node_modules` folder. I didn't install it because that downloads packages from npm. To run them, use `npm install` and then `npm test`. I also checked the `maxLength` cut logic by reading it, and it should satisfy the property tests' length and format checks. Say if you want me to run the install.
